import ctypes
import os


def load_gsl_libraries():
    # Load the BLAS library first with RTLD_GLOBAL
    libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)

    # Load the main GSL library
    libgsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    return libgsl


def get_solver_names(libgsl):
    # Define the structure for gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs
    class GSLMultifitNLinearTRS(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [
            ("name", ctypes.c_char_p),
            ("alloc", ctypes.c_void_p),
            ("init", ctypes.c_void_p),
            ("preloop", ctypes.c_void_p),
            ("step", ctypes.c_void_p),
            ("preduction", ctypes.c_void_p),
            ("free", ctypes.c_void_p)
        ]

    # Access the 'gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_dogleg' symbol
    gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_dogleg = ctypes.cast(
        libgsl.gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_dogleg,
        ctypes.POINTER(GSLMultifitNLinearTRS)
    )

    # Access the 'gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_ddogleg' symbol
    gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_ddogleg = ctypes.cast(
        libgsl.gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_ddogleg,
        ctypes.POINTER(GSLMultifitNLinearTRS)
    )

    # Extract the solver names
    try:
        dogleg_name = gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_dogleg.contents.name.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        dogleg_name = "unknown"

    try:
        ddogleg_name = gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_ddogleg.contents.name.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        ddogleg_name = "unknown"

    return dogleg_name, ddogleg_name


def assert_test():
    # Load the GSL libraries
    libgsl = load_gsl_libraries()

    # Get the solver names
    dogleg_name, ddogleg_name = get_solver_names(libgsl)

    # Assertions to validate correctness
    assert dogleg_name in ["dogleg", "unknown"], f"Expected 'dogleg' or 'unknown', got '{dogleg_name}'"
    assert ddogleg_name in ["double-dogleg", "unknown"], f"Expected 'double-dogleg' or 'unknown', got '{ddogleg_name}'"

    # Print the solver names
    print("Solver names:")
    print(f"Dogleg: {dogleg_name}")
    print(f"Double-Dogleg: {ddogleg_name}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
